steps.name: Open builder
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Itinerary**. Use **Build Itinerary** / **Edit Itinerary**.

steps.name: Midwinter visit date
steps.do: On **Set Visit Date**, pick a midwinter date (e.g. a day in January), then continue to **Add Animals**.

steps.name: Select off-display animal
steps.expect: **Animal May Be Off Display** confirmation appears.

steps.name: Cancel confirm
steps.expect: Animal is not added to the selection.

steps.name: Select again
steps.expect: **Animal May Be Off Display** appears again.

steps.name: Confirm add
steps.expect: Animal is added to the selection.

steps.name: Finish
steps.do: Finish the itinerary with that animal included.
